elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: The added provision applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
TrueLink must, at Client's request, “provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance must be provided “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at TrueLink's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides that assistance is supplied “at TrueLink's then-current rates.”

elements.element: TrueLink returns Customer Data to Client.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must “return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control.”

elements.element: Customer Data is returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return is required “within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: TrueLink deletes the returned Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return, TrueLink must “delete such Client Content and data from its systems.”

elements.element: TrueLink certifies deletion of the Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must “certify such deletion to Client in writing” after the return.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, TrueLink provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The provision requires transition assistance upon expiration or termination for any reason.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months at Client's request, which encompasses the required 90-day period.

elements.element: TrueLink exports Customer Data to Client.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in its possession or control.

elements.element: The Customer Data export occurs within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return is expressly required within thirty days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the preferred position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It addresses both expiry and termination, provides up to six months of requested assistance at then-current rates, requires return of Client data within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format, and requires subsequent deletion and written certification. The change is confined to transition and data-return obligations and does not disturb unrelated commercial terms.
